title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Generative AI Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Generative AI Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $90,000-$115,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are looking for an Generative AI Engineer to design, execute, and operationalize fine-tuning workflows for large language models across supervised, preference-based, and reinforcement learning approaches. The role requires deep practical experience with modern training stacks, careful dataset construction, rigorous evaluation methodology, and the engineering discipline to operate complex training pipelines reliably. The ideal candidate combines strong ML intuition with production-grade engineering practices, and is comfortable navigating the trade-offs between data quality, compute budget, evaluation rigor, and shipping velocity. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; or equivalent experience.

• Six or more years of combined ML research and engineering experience, with significant LLM exposure.

• Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks, especially PyTorch.

• Hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models at non-trivial scale.

• Familiarity with distributed training strategies including FSDP, ZeRO, and pipeline parallelism.

• Experience with RLHF, DPO, or other preference optimization techniques.

• Strong understanding of evaluation methodology, benchmarks, and human evaluation design.

• Experience operating training jobs on GPU clusters and recovering from failures.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Track record of shipping or publishing impactful LLM work.

Preferred Qualifications

• Publications at top-tier ML venues.

• Experience with multimodal model fine-tuning.

• Familiarity with synthetic data generation and dataset distillation.

• Open-source contributions to LLM training libraries.

• Exposure to responsible AI evaluation and red-teaming practices.

description:
About LOVB ( League One Volleyball ):
League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). But the volleyball market has been almost entirely missed by traditional sports investors, brands, and media.

LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. We are looking for a AI Engineer Intern to join us this summer and help build the next generation of AI-powered data tooling at Hex.

Our mission is to empower users to understand and work with data using natural language and agentic AI capabilities. As an intern, you’ll contribute directly to product and research that sits at the core of how data teams explore, analyze, and collaborate. While prior AI research experience is desired, we’re also looking for curiosity, enthusiasm, and a willingness to dive into fast-evolving technology.

This is an opportunity to learn from experienced engineers, ship real features to production, and contribute meaningfully to one of the most exciting technical spaces of our time.

- You are pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with plans to graduate in December 2027 or sometime in 2028

- You have AI research, applied AI, or ML experience, ideally having worked on substantive generative AI or transformer-based projects

- You have an interest in how you can build delightful product experiences backed by cutting edge technology, and an appetite for pushing the boundaries of what agents can accomplish

- You care about users and enjoy thinking about how technical systems translate into polished, intuitive experiences.

- You are curious, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as new technology emerges.

- You enjoy collaborating with others, asking questions, and learning from more senior engineers.

The compensation for this role is $11,000 a month + a housing stipend.

In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Damit Buena wächst, müssen Rechnungen stimmen, Zahlungen pünktlich ankommen und Finanzzahlen verlässlich sein. Als Werkstudent:in im Finance-Team sorgst du dafür.

Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben in der Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung, führst Zahlungen aus und hältst offene Posten im Blick. Du sorgst dafür, dass die BWAs unserer Holding und Tochtergesellschaften pünktlich und sauber vorliegen, und bereitest Zahlen für die interne Steuerung auf.

Du arbeitest direkt mit Finance Operations und unserem CFO zusammen. Dabei lernst du unsere Finanzstrukturen von Grund auf kennen und verbesserst die Prozesse, mit denen wir eine wachsende Unternehmensgruppe steuern.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Eingangsrechnungen und Zahlungsverkehr. Du betreust unseren Rechnungsworkflow von A bis Z: Rechnungseingang, fehlende Belege, Freigaben und Zahlungen. Du überwachst den Zahlungsverkehr der Gruppe und führst einen Großteil der freigegebenen Zahlungen selbst in Agicap aus.

- Ausgangsrechnungen und neue Geschäftsbereiche. Du behältst offene Posten im Blick, gleichst Zahlungseingänge ab und kümmerst dich um das Mahnwesen. Für neue Geschäftsbereiche baust du Abrechnungsprozesse mit auf - von der Rechnungsstellung bis zur Verbuchung.

- Buchungsqualität und BWAs. Du prüfst Konten, Kostenstellen und Steuersätze, bevor die Unterlagen an unsere Steuerberater gehen. Du klärst Rückfragen und hältst nach, dass die BWAs der Holding und unserer Tochtergesellschaften korrekt und fristgerecht vorliegen.

- Prozesse und Automatisierung. Du erkennst, wo Abläufe hängen oder Arbeit doppelt anfällt, und machst unsere Finanzprozesse schneller und verlässlicher.

- Reporting und Controlling. Du wertest Finanzdaten aus, bereitest sie für die interne Steuerung auf und machst Entwicklungen und Abweichungen früh sichtbar.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- Verantwortung übernimmst: Du erkennst offene Punkte, gehst ihnen nach und bringst deine Aufgaben zuverlässig zum Abschluss.

- Verstehst, warum die Kontenwahl relevant ist - für Reporting, Steuern und den Überblick über unser Geschäft.

- Gerne mit Zahlen arbeitest und Excel oder Google Sheets sicher beherrschst.

- Dich schnell in neue Tools einarbeitest und Lust hast, Finanzprozesse zu verbessern und zu automatisieren.

- Sorgfalt mit Pragmatismus verbindest: Du setzt Prioritäten, prüfst die entscheidenden Details und lieferst verlässliche Ergebnisse.

- An einer Hochschule eingeschrieben bist, beispielsweise in BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang, und mindestens zwölf Monate rund 20 Stunden pro Woche verfügbar bist.

- Fließend Deutsch und Englisch sprichst und schreibst. Mit Steuerberatern und Tochtergesellschaften kommunizierst du auf Deutsch, intern auf Englisch.

- Aus unserem Büro in Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten möchtest.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10-20 Gehminuten zum Büro wohnst oder dorthin ziehst.

- 110 €/Monat Lunch-Budget, 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

- 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen, eng vernetzten Team. Du siehst aus nächster Nähe, wie wir neue Hausverwaltungen übernehmen und unsere Finanzstrukturen weiterentwickeln.

- Wir sind meritokratisch. Wer zuverlässig liefert, bekommt bei uns schnell mehr Verantwortung.

- Wir sind persönlich. Wir arbeiten aus unserem Büro und legen großen Wert darauf, einander gut zu kennen.

- Wir bauen Buena langfristig auf. Wir machen Immobilien einfacher und schaffen die Grundlage, um Eigentum und Vermögensaufbau für mehr Menschen zugänglich zu machen.

title: Penetration Tester
description:
About the Role
The Penetration Tester works to execute offensive security activities across external networks, web applications, and APIs. In this role, you will be responsible for the execution of penetration testing engagements, including identifying, validating, and manually exploiting vulnerabilities, evaluating potential attack paths, and documenting findings and remediation guidance. As the Penetration Tester, you will provide exceptional technical and creative strategies to support the continued growth of our fast-paced company. A-LIGN will depend on you as the Penetration Tester to support management, independently execute assigned projects, communicate technical findings to clients, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our offensive security tools, methodologies, and delivery processes.
Reports to
Director, Web Application & External Offensive Operations
Pay Classification
Full-Time, Exempt
Responsibilities

• Execute external network, web application, and API penetration testing engagements in accordance with defined scopes, methodologies, and rules of engagement

• Identify, validate, and manually exploit vulnerabilities using public exploits, internally developed techniques, or a combination of approaches

• Evaluate attack paths and determine the potential business and technical impact of identified vulnerabilities

• Compile and write clear, accurate, and defensible client reports that explain findings, risk, evidence, and remediation guidance

• Communicate with clients throughout engagements, including technical discussions, findings walkthroughs, and responses to questions or challenges

• Execute assigned projects with minimal oversight while maintaining quality, professionalism, and attention to detail

• Collaborate with team members to evaluate offensive security tools and improve testing methodologies, delivery processes, and reporting standards

• Share technical knowledge and practical guidance with less-experienced team members and clients when appropriate

• Maintain current knowledge of emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, security research, and industry trends

Minimum Qualifications
EDUCATION

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, management information systems, computer science, or relevant discipline
EXPERIENCE

• 2-5 years of hands-on penetration testing experience in at least one of the following areas:

• External Penetration Tests

• Web Application Penetration Tests

• API Penetration Tests

• Mobile Application Penetration Tests

• Experience independently executing penetration testing engagements and producing high-quality client deliverables

• Knowledge of established penetration testing methodologies and disciplined evidence collection practices

• Experience identifying and manually validating exploitable vulnerabilities rather than relying solely on automated scanning

• Experience communicating technical findings, risk, and remediation guidance clearly to clients and internal stakeholders

CERTIFICATIONS

• Preferred OSCP, eWPT, eWPTX, OSWA, or OSWE certification
SKILLS

• Proficiency with commonly used offensive security tools such as Nmap, SQLmap, Burp Suite, Postman, Nuclei, Wireshark, Nessus, and Caido

• Proficiency with one or more scripting languages such as Python, Bash, JavaScript, PowerShell, or SQL

• Solid understanding of web technologies, networking concepts, authentication, access control, and common application security weaknesses

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a remote, fast-paced environment

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to different audiences

• Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining a high degree of motivation, self-discipline, and quality

Benefits

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision Benefits

• Employer Paid Life Insurance and Disability Insurance

• EAP - Employee Assistance Program

• Pet Insurance

• 401(k) Plan with Employer

title: Finance & Accounting Analyst
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX Brazil is building its finance function from the ground up while preparing for supervision by the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) under the new virtual asset service provider (SPSAV/PSAV) framework. We are looking for a Finance & Accounting Analyst to join our Brazil team and take ownership of core day-to-day accounting, accounts payable, and tax-compliance operations.

You will work alongside the Senior Finance Manager and the Finance & Accounting Specialist, in a role where accuracy, documentation, and discipline matter. Our books will soon be reviewed by a regulator, not only by auditors. This is a strong opportunity for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to financial regulation, crypto, and Brazil’s tax reform.

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Accounting & Month-End Close

•
Prepare monthly close activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, and recurring accounting schedules.

•
Prepare and review intercompany journal entries and reconcile intercompany balances with affiliates to ensure accuracy and consistency.

•
Maintain close checklists and supporting documentation in FloQast and NetSuite, meeting group reporting deadlines.

•
Support the local Portuguese-language books, helping keep entries aligned with Brazilian GAAP and the BCB chart of accounts (COSIF) as we prepare for regulated status.

•
Accounts Payable & Expense Management

•
Process vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, and weekly payment batches in line with internal policies and approval matrices.

•
Validate vendor documentation and apply the correct tax treatment before payment.

•
Review withholding taxes on vendor payments (IRRF, PIS/COFINS/CSLL, INSS, ISS), and keep payment files and supporting documents audit-ready.

•
Tax Compliance Support

•
Issue electronic invoices for company operations, ensuring accuracy and compliance with municipal and federal requirements.

•
Support the monthly review of VAT and CIT calculations and maintain supporting documentation.

•
Support tax-to-accounting reconciliations and coordinate with our outsourced accounting firm on filings and information requests.

•
Help us follow and prepare for the Brazilian tax reform (IBS/CBS) transition, including the impact on invoicing, vendor payments, and ERP configuration.

•
Audit & Controls

•
Support external audit and group-level audit requests: prepare PBC lists, schedules, and reconciliations.

•
Follow documented controls and flag exceptions or gaps. Contribute to SOPs and process improvements as we build a controlled environment suited to a regulated entity.

What We’re Looking For

•
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (CRC registration is a plus).

•
3+ years of experience in accounting, preferably in financial services, fintech, crypto, or big 4.

•
Solid knowledge of IFRS and BR GAAP/CPC. Familiarity with tax is a plus.

•
Hands-on experience with month-end closing, reconciliations, and AP processes.

•
Strong attention to detail, a sense of ownership, and the discipline to document your work.

•
Intermediate-to-advance

title: Une Ingénieure ou un Ingénieur : procédés et formation en salle blanche microélectronique - Centre Microélectronique de Provence – CDD 2 ans
description:
L’Institut Mines-Télécom est le premier groupe public français de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management. Il fédère huit écoles publiques, deux écoles filiales et un vaste réseau de partenaires académiques, industriels et institutionnels.
Mines Saint-Étienne, école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, assure des missions de formation, de recherche, d’innovation et de transfert industriel. Avec 2 500 élèves, 500 personnels et un budget de 50 M€, elle dispose de trois campus spécialisés. Sa stratégie 2023-2027 vise à accompagner les transitions écologique, numérique et générationnelle, tout en contribuant à la souveraineté nationale et européenne en microélectronique et numérique.
Le campus Aix-Marseille-Provence, situé à Gardanne, regroupe le Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), des formations d’ingénieurs et de masters, un incubateur technologique et des plateformes de prototypage. Il accueille environ 400 étudiants et 200 personnels de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’entreprises partenaires.
Le CMP dispose d’une salle blanche de 700 m², équipée d’une centaine d’équipements scientifiques répartis en zones de classes 100, 1 000 et 10 000. Cette plateforme est utilisée par les équipes de recherche, les membres académiques et industriels de l’association Micro-PackS, ainsi que pour les formations initiales et continues.
Ses activités couvrent notamment les procédés de couches minces, la photolithographie, la chimie, la caractérisation physique et électrique des matériaux et dispositifs, le micropackaging, l’électronique imprimée et la préparation d’échantillons.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous
Dans le cadre du projet I-novmicro porté par le Campus des Métiers et des Qualifications Industrie du Futur, des modules de formation aux procédés de fabrication en microélectronique sont proposés à des étudiants et apprenants en formation initiale ou continue. La formation se concentrera sur la réalisation de transistor NMOS.
Le Centre de Microélectronique de Provence recrute un ingénieur pour mettre en place et dispenser ces formations, gérer les opérations nécessaires au bon déroulement de celles-ci.

Vos Missions :
Achat d’équipements
La personne retenue gérera, dans un premier temps, l’achat de nouveaux équipements destinés aux formations décrites en introduction.
Mise en place de la formation
La personne sera chargée de développer le module de formation sur le transistor NMOS, en ciblant certains procédés de fabrication. Elle assurera ensuite l’animation des sessions de formation aux procédés microélectroniques associées à ce module.
Ainsi, la personne recrutée devra être former aux procédés standard utilisés en microélectronique (front-end), et effectuer les étapes de fabrication de composants, développées dans le cadre des formations dispensées. Elle sera également en charge du développement de nouveaux procédés. Dans le cadre de ces missions, la ou le titulaire du poste devra utiliser des produits chimiques, et donc en gérer les aspects sécurité. Elle devra utiliser des équipements de caractérisation (ex : microscopie, ellipsométrie, profilométrie) dans le cadre des formations dispensées, et devra pouvoir former des utilisateurs à ces techniques.
Recherche
Etant associé aux départements de recherche du CMP, notamment le département d’électronique flexible, des activités complémentaires de recherche sont envisageables.

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons
Les candidates et candidats doivent être titulaires au minimum d’un bac+5, et avoir une expérience dans la microélectronique, en process et caractérisation en salle blanche.
Une forte polyvalence est requise pour ce poste, avec notamment des compétences en :

• Procédés (connaissance et maîtrise) : photolithographie, gravure humide et sèche, dépôts de couches minces et traitements thermiques,

• Caractérisation physique de matériaux et dispositifs, et caractérisation électrique de dispositifs.

Une expérience dans le domaine de la formation technique est un réel atout.

Pave Bank is the world’s first programmable business bank. Built by the founders behind Monzo and BigPay, we are redefining global business banking by integrating programmable financial infrastructure with world-class client experiences.
About the Role:
As a Senior Trader at Pave Bank, you'll play a key role in executing multi-asset trading strategies and managing the bank's FX and digital asset exposures, liquidity, and treasury operations across global markets. Working across G20 and emerging-market FX, fixed income, derivatives, and digital assets/stablecoins, you'll help optimise trade execution, manage risk, and strengthen the bank's network of liquidity providers and OTC counterparties.
Beyond day-to-day trading, you'll have the opportunity to build and improve trading and treasury workflows, leveraging AI tools and automation to enhance efficiency, market analysis, and decision-making. title: Chief of Staff
description:
Über uns: Die Baubranche ist einer der größten Wirtschaftszweige der Welt - und einer der am wenigsten digitalisierten. Wir bei Cosuno ändern das. Deine Mission: Als Chief of Staff (Commercial Focus) bist du kein reiner Berater, sondern ein "Builder". Du fungierst als rechte Hand des C-Levels, löst unsere komplexesten Wachstumsherausforderungen und treibst strategische Initiativen von der ersten Hypothese bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung voran.

- Strategic Execution: Du übernimmst die Ownership für geschäftskritische Go-to-Market-Projekte über die Bereiche Enterprise Sales, Revenue Operations und Customer Success hinweg.

- Commercial Excellence: Du identifizierst Ineffizienzen in unseren Funnels, entwickelst datengetriebene Lösungsansätze und skalierst unseren Umsatzmotor (Pricing-Strategien, neue Marktsegmente, Sales-Zyklen-Optimierung).

- Cross-functional Leadership: Du agierst als Bindeglied zwischen den Commercial-Teams und Product/Tech, brichst Silos auf und sorgst dafür, dass alle an einem Strang ziehen, um unsere OKRs zu übertreffen.

- Executive Leverage: Du entlastest das Gründerteam und den CRO im operativen Tagesgeschäft, bereitest Board-Meetings vor und triffst eigenständig Vorabentscheidungen auf C-Level-Niveau.

Dein Profil: Wir suchen einen analytischen Vordenker mit einer absoluten "Get-shit-done"-Mentalität. Du kannst auf Flughöhe strategisch diskutieren, scheust dich aber nicht davor, tief in die Daten oder operativen Prozesse abzutauchen.
Top-Tier Erfahrung: Du bringst 2-3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung aus einer führenden Strategieberatung mit. Alternativ hast du bereits in einer ähnlich exponierten, strategischen Rolle in einem High-Growth B2B-SaaS-Umfeld massiven Impact bewiesen.
Commercial Acumen: Du hast eine starke Affinität zu B2B-Software-Metriken (ARR, CAC, LTV, Churn) und idealerweise bereits Projekte in den Bereichen GTM-Strategie, Sales Excellence oder Pricing begleitet.
Analytische Exzellenz: Du triffst Entscheidungen nicht aus dem Bauch heraus, sondern basierend auf Daten. Du beherrschst Financial/Commercial Modeling und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte in klare Handlungsempfehlungen übersetzen.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst präzise, auf den Punkt und kannst auf C-Level sowie im Board-Kontext souverän agieren.
Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Muttersprachenniveau) und exzellente Englischkenntnisse.

Warum Cosuno?
Massiver Impact & Sichtbarkeit: Deine Arbeit hat direkten, messbaren Einfluss auf den Erfolg und die Bewertung unseres Unternehmens.
Fast-Track Karriere: Die CoS-Rolle ist als Sprungbrett konzipiert. Beweist du dich hier, stehen dir langfristig Türen für Senior-Leadership-Rollen (z.B. VP, Head of) innerhalb von Cosuno offen.
Flexibilität & Kultur: Arbeite aus unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain oder nutze unser hybrides Modell. Wir pflegen eine Kultur der absoluten Transparenz, wenig Politik und schnellen Entscheidungen.
Das Setup: Ein unbefristeter Vertrag, State-of-the-art Equipment, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein extrem motiviertes, internationales Team, das gemeinsam gewinnen will.

title: Staff Engineer (AI Native)
description:
Buscamos a pessoa que será referência técnica em engenharia de software AI-native na Bemobi : quem define como os times especificam, delegam a agentes de IA e verificam o que é entregue, sem abrir mão dos fundamentos de arquitetura, qualidade e segurança.
Essa posição responde pelos padrões de desenvolvimento assistido por agentes - specs, contexto, guardrails, verificação e harness compartilhado - e pela confiabilidade do que vai para produção. Atua em desenvolvimento e operação, e mede sucesso por resultado para o negócio e para o usuário, não por volume de código gerado.
#BeABemober 💙🚀

• Especificação e contexto: definir o padrão de specs verificáveis - pré e pós-condições, invariantes, Given/When/Then - e manter o contexto que os agentes usam (, , skills e restrições).

• Decomposição e orquestração: quebrar problemas complexos em unidades que um agente executa e um humano consegue verificar, coordenando vários agentes, worktrees isoladas e passagens de bastão.

• Política de delegação: definir com os times o que se delega à IA (o que é fácil de verificar, de baixo risco ou repetitivo) e o que fica com as pessoas (design, decisões de produto e contexto organizacional).

• Verificação: estabelecer a estratégia de testes, evals, mutation testing e benchmarks, e levar a revisão de código para o foco em intenção e risco, que escala com o volume gerado por agentes.

• Guardrails determinísticos: garantir CI rigoroso, proteção de branch, CODEOWNERS, lotes pequenos e rollback fácil como base de confiança no sistema.

• Segurança desde o início: desenhar agentes com identidade própria, menor privilégio, sandbox e defesa em profundidade, em conjunto com Segurança da Informação.

• Harness como produto: evoluir o setup compartilhado de engenharia - instruções, ferramentas, hooks e skills - incorporando o que se aprende com cada falha.

• Operação e confiabilidade: definir níveis de autonomia dos agentes em produção (L0 a L3), com autorização progressiva, dry-run e mecanismo de parada imediata; tratar cada agente como serviço, com SLOs, observabilidade e plano de contingência.

• IA na operação: aplicar IA onde ela agrega - playbooks, detecção de anomalia, RCA, rascunho de postmortem e handoff de incidente - sem substituir automação clássica que já resolve.

• Formação do time: mentorar ativamente, em especial juniores e plenos, e manter trilhas de fundamentos com prática deliberada sem IA, combatendo a atrofia de habilidades.

• Comunicação com o negócio: traduzir limites, riscos e ganhos da IA para liderança e áreas de negócio, sustentando decisões técnicas com dados.

• Experiência sólida em engenharia de software, com atuação como referência técnica (Staff, Principal ou Tech Lead) em sistemas de produção de alta escala.

• Fundamentos fortes: arquitetura, estruturas de dados, invariantes e fronteiras de segurança - a base para identificar código gerado "quase certo".

• Uso intensivo e comprovado de agentes de IA no dia a dia de desenvolvimento, com domínio de context engineering e spec-driven development.

• Prática em TDD, testes automatizados e evals, e capacidade de desenhar estratégias de verificação para código gerado por IA.

• Vivência com CI/CD, controle de versão, proteção de branch e entrega em lotes pequenos.

• Vivência em operação de sistemas: observabilidade, SLOs, resposta a incidentes e postmortems.

• Segurança aplicada: menor privilégio, isolamento e gestão de identidades e segredos.

• Julgamento e desconfiança calibrada: saber quando parar e conferir, sem rejeitar a IA nem confiar cegamente nela.

• Pensamento sistêmico e de risco, com foco em resultado para o negócio e para o usuário.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas, liderança e negócio, e disposição real para mentorar.

title: Frontend Engineer - Internship

INTERNSHIP DETAILS & WHAT YOU GET

- London

- San Francisco

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

WHY CERTA

title: Deal Strategy
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

You will own the commercial structuring and economics of Baseten's highest-priority customer deals end to end. You will play a critical role in scaling our revenue by serving as a trusted partner to Sales, Finance, and Legal on complex and non-standard deals. You'll help our products reach customers quickly while maintaining the financial discipline and risk management that a fast-scaling AI company requires.

This role is ideal for someone who has excellent commercial judgment, is highly analytical, and wants to build the deal strategy function from the ground up at a hypergrowth company. You'll help define how the world's leading AI companies buy inference and directly impact our most strategic customer relationships.

THE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Deal Structuring: Partner with Sales to structure deals that meet customer needs while protecting Baseten's financial and strategic interests, spanning pricing, discounts, commitments, and contract terms.

- Customer Negotiations: Join customer conversations and represent Baseten with senior finance and procurement stakeholders, bringing pricing and commercial depth so the account team can stay focused on the relationship.

- Financial Analysis: Conduct deal profitability, margin, and discount impact analysis, and translate the results into clear, data-driven recommendations for leadership.

- Deal Review and Approvals: Review enterprise deals that fall outside standard parameters, and own the approval thresholds and escalation paths that keep decisions moving quickly.

- Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Legal, Revenue Accounting, RevOps, and Billing to ensure every deal is contracted, booked, and billed accurately.

- Pricing Insights: Track discounting, win rates, and deal outcomes across the book, and use those insights to shape pricing, packaging, and commercial policy.

- Process and Systems: Build the playbooks, guidelines, and workflows that let our deal process scale with the business. Use AI and automation extensively to keep the function fast and lean as deal volume grows.

THE REQUIREMENTS

- 8+ years of experience in deal strategy, pricing, strategic finance, investing, and/or revenue operations at a high-growth technology company

- Proven track record of structuring and negotiating complex enterprise deals, especially in a consumption-based environment

- Strong commercial judgment, with the presence to negotiate directly with customers and represent Baseten externally

- Excellent system design, financial modeling, and analytical skills

- Ability to earn the trust of sales teams and influence senior leaders across Sales, Finance, and Legal

- Proficiency in CPQ/CRM tools and a strong understanding of how deal terms affect billing and revenue recognition

- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn complex deal structures into clear recommendations for executives

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE

- Experience at an AI, cloud infrastructure, or data platform company

- Familiarity with GPU and compute economics

- Experience building a deal desk or deal strategy function from scratch

- Prior quantitative experience

BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

- (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

- Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Productions
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Productions is the “done for you” managed services wing of ElevenLabs, built for creators and media businesses. La production de béton est responsable d'environ 8 % des émissions mondiales de CO2. Ces émissions sont principalement liées à la combustion et à la décarbonatation du calcaire nécessaire à la production du ciment Portland conventionnel.
Les liants à base de magnésie (MgO) sont étudiés comme alternatives potentielles aux ciments conventionnels, avec une empreinte carbone réduite. Le magnésium nécessaire à leur production pourrait être extrait de roches non carbonatées ou de saumures riches en magnésium. Ces ressources constituent des sources alternatives de matières premières et pourraient permettre d'éviter les émissions de CO2 liées à la décarbonatation du calcaire.
Cependant, ces liants alternatifs sont encore en cours de développement et leurs mécanismes d'hydratation, leur composition et leurs propriétés mécaniques doivent être mieux compris. En particulier, la nature et la réactivité de la source de magnésium, ainsi que les conditions de formulation et de préparation, peuvent influencer la microstructure et les performances mécaniques du matériau obtenu.
L'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier différentes sources de magnésium et d'évaluer leur potentiel pour le développement de liants de type MgO-SiO2 présentant de bonnes propriétés mécaniques et un impact environnemental réduit.
Plusieurs formulations de liants seront préparées et étudiées en faisant varier la source de magnésium et différents paramètres de formulation. Les matériaux obtenus seront caractérisés à l'aide de techniques complémentaires afin d'évaluer leur composition chimique, les phases formées lors de l'hydratation, leur microstructure, leur porosité et leurs propriétés mécaniques. title: Case Manager
description:
Job Description
We’re hiring a Case Manager to join the Medicare Case Management team! Dependent on clinical discipline, the Case Manager coordinates appropriate care, resources and/or services of selected member populations. Provides guidance and promotes effective utilization and monitoring of health care resources to drive quality care for our members. Collaborates as needed with varied members of the healthcare team to achieve optimal clinical and/or resource outcomes. At Blue Cross NC , we’re making health care better for all - by listening deeply, challenging what’s possible, and putting care at the heart of everything we do. Join a purpose driven team where ideas spark change, growth is encouraged, collaboration fuels impact, and you’re supported with the flexibility and trust to do meaningful work.
What You’ll Do

• Serve as a team member on a multidisciplinary team, coordinating care, resources and/or services for members to achieve optimal clinical and resource outcomes.

• Utilize applicable clinical skillset and perform comprehensive assessments to determine how to best collaborate with members, family, internal partners and external services/providers on plans for treatment, appropriate intervention and/or discharge planning.

• Develop a member-centric plan tailored to members’ needs, health status, educational status and level of support needs; identify barriers to meeting goals or plan of care.

• Utilize community resources and funding sources as needed in the development of the plan of care.

• Perform ongoing monitoring and management of member which may include scheduled follow-up with member, discussion of plan with member, appropriate services/education to address needs, appropriate referrals with supporting documentation, assessment of progress towards goals, modification of plan/goals as needed, with contact frequency appropriate to member acuity.

• Evaluate and facilitate care provided to members through the continuum of care (physician office, hospital, rehabilitation unit, skilled nursing facility, home care, etc).

• Educate members and encourage pro-active intervention to limit expense and encourage positive outcomes

• Effectively document all aspects of the plan from the initial assessment, development of the plan, implementation, monitoring, and evaluating outcome.

• May outreach directly to members identified as high risk, high cost, or high utilization cases.

• May review alternative treatment plans for case management candidates and assess available benefits and the need for benefits exception or flex benefit options, where eligible.

• May evaluate medical necessity and appropriateness of services as defined by department.

• As needed, develop relevant policies/procedures, education or training for use both internally and externally.

What You Bring

• RN with 3 years of clinical and/or case management experience required.

• Must have and maintain a valid and applicable clinical license (NC or compact multi-state licensure) to perform described job duties.

• For some roles, additional specialty certification (i.e. CCM, CDCES) may be required. If so, incumbents must obtain relevant certification within 2 years of employment.

At this time, Blue Cross NC will not sponsor employment authorization for this position.
Bonus Points (Preferred Qualifications)

• Previous telephonic/remote case management experience

• Previous experience working in the health insurance industry preferred.

What You’ll Get

• The opportunity to work at the cutting edge of health care delivery with a team that’s deeply invested in the community 

• Work-life balance, flexibility, and the autonomy to do great work  

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage along with numerous health and wellness programs  

• Parental leave and support plus adoption and surrogacy assistance  

• Career development programs and tuition reimbursement for continued education  

• 401k match including an annual company contribution

title: Lead Security Engineer
description:
ABOUT BUFFER

We create social media and brand-building software for small businesses, creators, and individuals. Our mission is to provide essential tools to help small businesses get off the ground and grow. Through exceptional customer service and uplifting content, we help our customers believe they can succeed and do good along the way.

Buffer is a fully distributed team, and we’ve always aimed to do things a little differently. Since the early days, we’ve focused on building one of the most unique and fulfilling workplaces by rethinking a lot of traditional practices. We also default to transparency, so you can read all about our metrics, and our successes and failures along the way on our Transparency Dashboard https://buffer.com/open.

We're united by Buffer's values https://buffer.com/about#values, and we hire and work from all over the world. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive work environment, and we are building a culture where underrepresented groups are welcome and can flourish. Please note that we do travel to work together in person once or twice per year, and those events are highly encouraged to build deeper connections among our small team.

As you get to know Buffer and consider joining the journey, you can learn more about Buffer on our Journey https://buffer.com/journey page. Still curious to learn more about the experience on the Buffer team? Feel free to read more from Kirsti https://buffer.com/resources/first-30-days-buffer/ and Sabreen https://buffer.com/resources/joined-3-days-before-the-retreat/ as they share their first experiences with Buffer, as well as from Hailley https://buffer.com/resources/8-years-at-buffer/, who captured why she still calls Buffer home after 8+ years.

While unusual at Buffer, we're looking for folks in a specific timezone range. This role is currently open to candidates based between UTC-3 and UTC+3. That gives you overlap with our current security engineer in Sri Lanka and most of our Engineering team, and lets the two of you share incident coverage so neither of you has to work through the night.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a hands-on security engineer to be the tech lead for Buffer's Security team. You'll work alongside Adnan https://www.linkedin.com/in/adnanissadeen/, who has carried security at Buffer for years. Together, you’ll own security and compliance for a 15-year-old profitable company that is rebuilding itself around AI.

Two things make this the right moment. Buffer’s product surface is growing: in May, we launched a public GraphQL API with an MCP server and CLI. More than 35,000 organizations have connected an AI tool to Buffer, and we are planning to build a plugin ecosystem on top. Internally, we're becoming an AI-native organization: MCPs on our Claude Team plan, custom connectors, internal tools, and Roo, our own internal agent. We're small and lean, with few processes, and we run on trust around access and permissions. We don't want to lose that, but the surface now grows faster than one person can cover.

That means the usual security playbook won't work here. We don't buy enterprise plans for every tool, and we don't make people justify every access request. You’ll make the secure path the easy path to follow.

Your role will be to set the direction for security at Buffer and to do much of the work yourself. You'll decide which open security problems to address first, write code to fix some of them, and lead incidents when they happen. We're looking for an enabler and a team player, not a gatekeeper. This is a generalist role by design.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll report to Miguel, https://www.linkedin.com/in/migueldavid/ Engineering Manager for the Infrastructure and Security teams.

Day-to-day, the Security team is you, Adnan, and Miguel. Adnan knows how everything at Buffer fits together and where the sharp edges are. Together, you’ll own planned security work as well as the work that keeps the lights on: the security inbox, requests

title: Product Designer, Chemistry

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Product Design team at Benchling is committed to building user experiences that support the scientists who are solving the world’s most important problems. Our work has a direct impact on making scientific workflows more efficient while improving the quality of that research-ultimately helping to drive the biotech revolution.

We’re looking for an experienced Product Designer to help build Benchling’s small molecule solution, enabling scientists to discover and develop small molecules and hybrid modalities with the same power and collaboration Benchling brings to biologics. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for this critical product area, working cross-functionally with scientists, engineers, designers, and GTM teams to bring new capabilities to life.

This role will also contribute to platform-level initiatives including new homepage and navigation features that tie into the day-to-day work of a chemist.

An ideal person for this team will be able to balance customer needs and priorities with scalable, consistent, delightful user experiences in an agile environment.

- Work with Product Management and Engineering teams to define product strategy, scope, and prioritization in a startup-like environment

- Work through product problems from definition and opportunity to shipping features to our customers

- Design and prototype multiple ideas quickly to validate product directions

- Own the design for high-impact initiatives from research through implementation

- 5+ years of experience* driving the design of software products, ideally SaaS, while maintaining a relentless focus on the user

- A strong portfolio of relevant design work that conveys an ability to ship successful products

- A track record of working with and simplifying complex product architectures or workflows

- Strong communication skills and ability to explain the reasoning behind complex decisions

- Experience contributing to a design system for complex software products

- Experience working with Product Management, Engineers, and fellow Designers in an agile environment

- A background with lab work, scientific research, or healthcare will serve you well in this role-but it is not a requirement.

Have well over 5 years of experience? That's great! Have fewer than 5 years, but feel you meet the other requirements? That's ok too! Please apply.

title: Major Enterprise Account Executive

Description
Today, every organisation faces a choice: keep pouring money into observability, or start treating telemetry as what it really is: the most real-time, truthful, high-dimensional data in the business.
Coralogix is built for the second answer. We're a modern, full-stack observability platform powered by a telemetry data lake and an in-stream analytics architecture that decouples cost from scale. Instead of forcing customers into expensive indexing and hot storage, we analyse data in-stream and query directly from the customer's own bucket using our declarative query language. This delivers complete coverage across logs, metrics, traces, and security events (APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes, and more) without the trade-offs.
The result is compounding value for our customers: from open data collection and control, from a long-term telemetry data lake they actually own, and from observability that connects directly to business outcomes. Legacy tools compound in the opposite direction: compounding costs, vendor lock-in, and scale problems around mapping, retention, and cardinality. That's why Coralogix is increasingly displacing not just observability incumbents, but parts of adjacent data and analytics stacks too.
As a Major Enterprise Account Executive , you'll own complex, technical sales cycles end-to-end, from first conversation with a CTO to closed-won. You'll work alongside experienced solution engineers, partner with senior technical and business stakeholders, and play a central role in shaping how some of EMEA’s most demanding engineering organisations approach observability and telemetry data.
This is field sales for true hunters. You'll be selling a differentiated product into accounts that often already have an incumbent, which means you'll build the business case, create the urgency, and earn the share. We run a structured Coralogix sales playbook, founded in MEDDIC, and built around Proof of Value, executive-level value selling, and disciplined qualification. title: Senior Payroll Analyst & Administrator
description:
Dura-Line is hiring for a Senior Payroll Analyst & Administrator
Location: Remote (US)
About Orbia Connectivity Solutions Dura-Line:
Join Dura‑Line, an Orbia Connectivity Solutions business, where we create solutions that connect people and information across the globe. As a leading global manufacturer of conduit products and accessories, Dura‑Line creates the pathways that power connectivity across a wide range of markets worldwide. Quality, safety, and sustainability are at the core of everything we do, with environmentally responsible practices embedded throughout our manufacturing processes. Be part of our shared mission with Orbia to Advance Life Around the World.
Dura-Line is seeking to hire a Senior Payroll Analyst & Administrator who will be responsible for collecting, compiling, and processing all payroll data to ensure accurate and timely bi-weekly payrolls for the United States for fifteen locations and Canada for two locations. The Senior Payroll Analyst & Administrator will understand and influence the payroll system configuration through recommendations, testing, validations, etc., and provide detailed reporting to support business functions and payroll inquiries.
Key Responsibilities:

• Process bi-weekly United States and Canada payrolls using Ceridian Dayforce System

• Review and validate employee time-keeping inputs and the downloaded information from electronic time-keeping systems at offsite locations for completeness and accuracy

• Work with local and state tax authorities on garnishments, including answering inquiries & paperwork

• Monitor and audit payroll data such as Paid Time Off payout, disability pay, leave pay, incentive pay, court orders, garnishments, and other required deductions

• Submit reporting for 401(k) and FSA accounts to program administrator(s) upon committing the payroll

• Work directly with corresponding plant Human Resources People Business Partners on reconciling payroll discrepancies

• Create reports as needed to support analysis of any activity processed through the payroll system.

• Reconcile all pay reports to payroll data for pay period(s). Prepare quarterly and year-end payroll reconciliations

• Support review and analysis of all payroll outputs by providing data and reports

• Review and resolve payment concerns from end users and leadership

• Complete special projects as assigned by management

Requirements:

• Academic Level - Associate's Degree, Bachelor’s Degree Preferred, or related work experience

• Language(s) and level of proficiency: English

•
Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• 5+ years of payroll administration experience for the United States and Canada

• Experience running payroll for companies with more than 1000 employees

• Computer proficiency including strong Excel experience

• Experience using a medium- to large-scale cloud payroll software solution similar to or including ADP, SAP, Ceridian, Workday, etc.

• Work Experience: 3 years or more experience running non-exempt and exempt payroll

Our Offer:

• 401(k) with 6% company match, plus an automatic additional 3% employer contribution

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits beginning day one

• Employer‑paid Short‑Term & Long‑Term Disability and Life Insurance

• Wellness programs including EAP, paid parental leave, fitness and weight‑loss reimbursement

• Tuition reimbursement, 11 paid company holidays, paid vacation and sick time

• Career development opportunities in a collaborative culture focused on work‑life balance, innovation, and teamwork

JOIN OUR GROWING TEAM TODAY!
As part of Orbia Connectivity Solutions, Dura-Line offers an exciting work environment and career opportunities in a continuously growing company. We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce that reflects our global customer base.
Acquisition based on this vacancy is not appreciated and unsolicited applications from third parties will not be accepted .
